notes.title: v.1.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.content: Fixed camera bugs in Big Kitchen levels 6 & 7

notes.title: v1.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed jumping gravity glitch when playing 2 player mode
[*] Fixed Build UI glitch when playing in 2 player mode
[*] Fixed glitch that would soft lock game when returning to pause menu from settings menu in 2 player mode
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2 is LIVE! Play with your friends!
notes.content:
v1.2.0 patch notes:

[list]
[*] [b]New Movement: Strafing[/b]
Strafing will allow players to shoot toast forward while moving backwards.

[*][b] Local Co-Op Added[/b]
Ivan the Toaster Oven joins the party! Play with a friend to protect the toaster together!

[*] [b]Level Lighting Changes[/b]
All levels have undergone lighting changings.
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.1.0 is live and brings new features!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Story Levels Now Have Star Ratings
[*] New Enemy: Small Crawler 
[*] Hit Combo Multiplier
[*] Toast Bullet Hitbox Adjustment
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Space Level 2 & 3 order switched
[*] New Space Level 2 Wave Completion (15 --> 10)
[*] New Space Level 3 Time Completion (12min --> 8min)
[*] Space Level 4 Time Completion (10min --> 8min)
[*] Space Level 5 Wave Completion (30 --> 20)
[*] Space Level 6 Wave Completion (20 --> 15)
[*] Space Level 7 Time Completion (20mins --> 15min)
[*] Fixed glitch where toast would sometimes hit coins
[*] Endless Mode Level Select Redesign
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Big Kitchen Level 6 Wave Completion (10 --> 5)
[*] Adjusted Player Hitbox and Hurtbox
[*] Reload Time (3s --> 2.5s)
[*] Player Knockback Invincibility Time (1s --> 1.25s)
[*] Dash Invincibility Frames (22f --> 24f)
[*] Player UI Scale Increase
[*] Fixed glitch where player wouldn't turn around while game was in slow motion
[*] Lamp Fire Rate (1s --> .75s)
[*] Upgraded Lamp Fire Rate ( .5s --> .33s)
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.0.6

- Puncher Hitbox Adjustment
- Reload "Jam" Glitch Fix
- Sewer Level 9 & 10 Balance Fix
- Enemies have a higher chance of giving more coins upon destruction
- Fixed glitch that gave double heart/coins from Tina

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5 live!
notes.content:
- Added additional tutorials for first time players
- Story level balances
- All enemies slightly slowed down

notes.title: Toaster Defense will release on May 23rd!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Nathan, your friendly Toaster Defense developer, here! I wanted to share the news with all of you that Toaster Defense will be releasing on May 23rd! That's less than two weeks! Share the news with everyone you know and love!

In the mean time, here is my devlog showing off some of the cool things that you can expect to see when the game releases!
[previewyoutube=PyGhQ2DT_b8;full][/previewyoutube]
